summary: End-to-end frontend regression for Phase: (1) Patient Identity Linking and (2) Secure Patient Document Delivery. Mobile viewport (430x900) used for portal screens, desktop (1920x1080) for internal. All 11 explicit checkpoints PASSED via UI. Flow executed: maria.lopez@demo.com created an Ultrasound/Neck imaging request (IMG-000008). Logged in as staff (staff@visita.demo) → /internal/imaging → opened IMG-000008 → uploaded /tmp/testpdf/sample.pdf via attachment-file-input → saw INTERNAL badge (attachment-badge-internal-att_4ff4c0c6ee5742e7) + 'File attached (internal — not visible to patient)' toast → clicked attachment-share-<id> → native window.confirm auto-accepted → SHARED badge rendered (attachment-badge-shared-<id>), toast 'Document shared with patient. Patient notified.', and IMG-000008 status in queue flipped to Completed. Re-logged in as maria.lopez@demo.com → /portal shows new-update-card ABOVE upcoming-appointment-card (top=161px vs 337px) with new-update-badge '1'. Clicking new-update-view navigates to /portal/documents listing exactly 1 document-item with service label 'Imaging' + ref IMG-000008 + shared timestamp; document-view-<id> and document-download-<id> buttons rendered. Returning to /portal shows new-update-card is GONE (marked read); /portal/documents still lists the document (persistence after read). Isolation: john.smith@demo.com /portal/documents = documents-empty state (no documents); direct API call /api/portal/documents returned 401 for unauth test but UI empty state confirms isolation (backend already curl-verified per task note). Requests & Help (/portal/messages, as maria): zero textareas (no free-text), route-document-request opens document-request-panel, clicking doc-purpose-copy_imaging shows success toast 'Your document request was sent to the clinic.' and creates MSG-000021 'Results / Document Request — Copy of an imaging report' visible in staff /internal/messages queue. Identity Link: registered new 'Martin Rodolfo ARDIAN' DOB 1970-03-26 private patient via /register (ardian.qa.<ts>@demo.com / Patient2026!) which auto-logged into /portal with 'Account verification pending'. Staff → /internal/verifications → verif-tab-identity → exactly 1 identity-item showing ARDIAN with 1 identity-candidate 'VISITA #1146'; clicking identity-link-<candidateId> toasted 'Linked to canonical patient · VISITA #1146.' and the ARDIAN row disappeared from the Identity Link Review queue (0 items remaining). Regression: Mark Under Review action worked on non-shared IMG-000003 (status flipped to Under Review); /internal/messages still renders 8 historical message rows unchanged.
critical_code_review_comments: Attachments.jsx uses native window.confirm for the share action — functional but non-styled; consider replacing with the project AlertDialog for consistency with other confirms and better mobile UX.

Register.jsx: for patient_type='private' the Health Card issue/expiry date fields are NOT shown (HC fields only render when type==='ohip'). The review request mentioned supplying those for private — if they are required by the Private flow server-side, the UI must expose them; otherwise the task note is spurious. Current UI accepted the private registration without HC fields and identity-link matched by name+DOB successfully.

Created document request message MSG-000021 under maria.lopez. Registered new portal patient 'Martin Rodolfo ARDIAN' (private, DOB 1970-03-26, email ardian.qa.1790821109@demo.com) and LINKED it to canonical VISITA #1146. Also moved IMG-000003 from New -> Under Review during regression check. These are intentional test artifacts; main agent can leave or clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Patient Share flow uses window.confirm — register a page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) handler before clicking attachment-share-<id>. new-update-card is removed from the DOM once the single update is marked read (the API call fires inside new-update-view onClick before navigation). Register flow with patient_type=private does NOT expose Health Card issue/expiry fields — ignore those fields from the task spec. ARDIAN directory record maps to VISITA #1146; after one successful link the identity-item disappears (no retest possible on same account unless unlinked). To exercise identity-link again, register another ARDIAN-like name+DOB with a new unique email.
